name: lulu
description: Lulu: turn any two phones into a private, smart baby monitor.

scripts.setup: npm --prefix packages/core install && npm --prefix harness install && npm --prefix supabase/tests install && npm --prefix apps/web install && npm --prefix apps/mobile install
scripts.test: npm --prefix packages/core test && npm --prefix supabase/tests test && npm --prefix harness run gate
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix packages/core run typecheck && npm --prefix harness run typecheck && cd apps/mobile && npx tsc --noEmit && cd ../web && npx tsc --noEmit
